# CodeCanyon

> CodeCanyon is a marketplace for buying and selling 38,000+ plugins, scripts, and code components across web technologies including WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, and .NET.

CodeCanyon serves as a central hub for developers and businesses to discover, purchase, and sell pre-built code solutions. The platform features curated collections, top-ranked authors, and specialized integrations with popular tools like Elementor and WooCommerce.

## Key Topics

- WordPress plugins
- PHP scripts
- JavaScript code
- Code marketplace
- Web development
- Bootstrap templates
- HTML5 components
- WooCommerce integrations
- Elementor compatibility
- SaaS products
- Author rankings
- Digital products
- Plugin marketplace
- Code-as-a-service

## Browse & Discover

- [CodeCanyon Homepage](https://codecanyon.net): Main marketplace entry point: 38,026+ plugins, scripts, and code across multiple tech stacks.
- [Browse Categories](https://codecanyon.net/category): Category browser for JavaScript, PHP, .NET scripts and code components.
- [Featured Files](https://codecanyon.net/feature): Curated and featured code marketplace selections including ScheduleX and weekly picks.
- [Public Collections](https://codecanyon.net/collections): Curated collections across Envato ecosystem: Themeforest, Audiojungle, GraphicRiver.
- [User Feed](https://codecanyon.net/follow_feed): Personalized feed showcasing WordPress, PHP, Bootstrap, and HTML5 plugins and scripts.

## Integrations & Compatibility

- [Elementor Compatible Plugins](https://codecanyon.net/attributes/compatible-with/elementor): 1,633 Elementor-compatible WordPress plugins and WooCommerce integrations.

## Authors & Sellers

- [Top Authors](https://codecanyon.net/authors/top): Leaderboard of top CodeCanyon authors including themepunch, wpbakery, and Nota-info.
- [Top New Authors](https://codecanyon.net/page/top_new_sellers): Directory of emerging CodeCanyon sellers and new author rankings.

## Optional

- [baevox Profile](https://codecanyon.net/user/baevox): Vendor profile page for baevox with portfolio and sales metrics.
- [TheQuickCode Profile](https://codecanyon.net/user/thequickcode): TheQuickCode vendor profile featuring QR Code Generator and portfolio.
